camera.permissionDenied: Camera permission denied. Please allow camera access and try again.

scanEngine.phoneCaptureFailed: Phone didn't respond with a photo in time.

connectionFailed.title: Connection failed
connectionFailed.description: Failed to connect. Make sure no other application is using the device.

serial.bluetoothPermissionBlocked: Bluetooth permission is blocked for this browser. Check your browser's site settings (or chrome://settings/content/bluetoothDevices) to allow Bluetooth, then try again.

connectionLost.title: Connection lost
connectionLost.description: The sorter disconnected unexpectedly. If you're connected over USB, make sure no other application (like the Arduino IDE's Serial Monitor) is using the port, then reconnect.

deviceTestFailed.title: Device test failed
deviceTestFailed.description: Connected but got no response. Try reconnecting.

hardwareIdMismatch.title: Connected to a different sorter
hardwareIdMismatch.description: This board's ID doesn't match the one this org last connected to. Calibration was saved for a different physical unit.

serial.firmwareOutdatedBanner: Your sorter is running firmware v{{version}}, older than the latest v{{latest}}. Re-upload firmware/main/main.ino to update it.
serial.firmwareVersionMissingBanner: Your sorter's firmware doesn't report a version and can't be used to scan. Re-upload the latest firmware/main/main.ino to enable scanning.

update.dialogDescription: Flashes the latest firmware to your connected ESP32 over this browser tab. Don't disconnect the device or close this tab while it's in progress.
update.flashing: Flashing, do not disconnect the device…
update.success: Firmware flashed. Disconnect the sorter from your computer, then plug it back in to finish.

noCollectionSelected.title: No collection selected
noCollectionSelected.description: Create or select a collection before scanning.

collectionLocked.title: Collection locked
collectionLocked.description: Another org member is currently scanning into this collection.

scanLimitReached.title: Daily scan limit reached
scanLimitReached.description: Upgrade to Business for unlimited scanning.

routingFailed.title: Routing failed
routingFailed.description: No response from sorter for bin {{binNumber}}.

routingFailedCatchAll.title: Routing failed
routingFailedCatchAll.description: No response from sorter for catch-all bin {{binNumber}}.

jamDetected.title: Card jam detected
jamDetected.description: Card stuck at module {{module}}. Check the sorter and resume.
jamDetected.descriptionWithBin: Card stuck at module {{module}} (heading to bin {{bin}}). Check the sorter and resume.

noCardDetected.title: No card detected
noCardDetected.description: Module 1's sensor doesn't see a card - feed one before scanning.

clearFailed.title: Clear failed
clearFailed.description: Could not send command to the device.

clearTimeout.title: Clear timeout
clearTimeout.description: Device did not respond in time.

deviceCleared.title: Device cleared
deviceCleared.description: All bottom paddles were opened to drop any stuck cards.

gameSwitchAlert.message: When switching game types, you may have to re-adjust the feeder module tube wall.

scanStats.emptyState: Scan cards to see their stats.

ocrBetaDialog.title: OCR text matching (beta)
ocrBetaDialog.description: This reads the set code and collector number off the scanned card image to help pick the right printing. It's still in beta, so it can occasionally pick up extra text from the card or misread it. Turn it back off if it seems to be making matches worse.

phoneCamera.scanDescription: Scan this QR code on your phone, or open the link, so it can be used as this scanner's camera.
phoneCamera.connectedDescription: Your phone is ready. It'll take a photo whenever this scanner needs one.
phoneCamera.qrAlt: QR code to pair a phone camera
phoneCamera.statusError: Couldn't reach the phone. Make sure it's still open on this page, then try again.
phoneCamera.sessionEndedDescription: The scanner disconnected this camera. You can turn off the camera or scan a new QR code to reconnect.

scannerOverlay.apiDown: {{api}} is currently down, so scanning is disabled for this collection until it's back. Check the status page for updates.
scannerOverlay.dailyLimitReached: Daily scan limit reached. Upgrade to Business for unlimited scanning.
scannerOverlay.connectCamera: Connect a camera to start scanning.
scannerOverlay.waitingForPhone: Waiting for a phone to pair as the camera. Use the camera menu to show the QR code.
scannerOverlay.phoneReadyNoPhoto: Phone camera ready. It'll take a photo as soon as a card arrives.
scannerOverlay.autoFeedOff: Auto-feed is off, feed cards manually.
scannerOverlay.firmwareVersionMissing: Card sorter firmware doesn't report a version. Re-upload the latest firmware/main/main.ino to enable scanning.
scannerOverlay.noCatchAllBin: No catch-all bin configured, so unmatched cards won't be sorted.
scannerOverlay.paused: Scanner paused. Press Resume to continue.
scannerOverlay.duplicate: Same card scanned. Use Add Again to add it anyway.
scannerOverlay.noMatch: Card not recognized. Try Scan Again or adjust lighting.

monitorPage.noCardsMatchSearch: No cards match the search query.

binLimitDialog.title: Bin {{number}} is full
binLimitDialog.description: Bin {{number}} has reached its limit of {{limit}} cards. Remove the cards from the bin, then continue scanning.

feederEmpty.title: Feeder empty
feederEmpty.description: No cards remaining in the hopper. Add more cards to continue.

feederTimeoutDescription: Feeder did not respond in time.
cameraAccessError: Could not access camera. Please check your device.

staleDeviceDialog.title: Been a while since this org connected
staleDeviceDialog.description: This device's calibration hasn't changed in over 30 days. Run the self-test as-is, or calibrate first to make sure everything still matches the physical hardware.
